plan.understanding: You want a quick way for students to log what they spend and see where their money goes. It should be fast to use between classes, with nothing to sign up for.
plan.summary: A small expense tracker that totals spending and filters it by category.
plan.target_user: College students managing a monthly budget
mvp_features: Add an expense with amount and category

decisions.title: How should people move around?
decisions.context: Students log expenses in a hurry, so every extra tap costs something.

options.label: Single screen
options.benefit: Add, filter and review spending without leaving the page.
options.cost: The screen gets crowded as features grow.

options.label: Two tabs
options.benefit: Adding and reviewing each get their own clean space.
options.cost: One extra tap before every review.

decisions.title: How should items be shown?
decisions.context: An expense is mostly an amount and a category, which is little to show per item.

options.label: List
options.benefit: Many expenses fit on screen, so you can scan the whole month quickly.
options.cost: Rows look plain and carry little visual personality.

options.label: Cards
options.benefit: Each expense stands out with room for a category colour.
options.cost: Far fewer expenses are visible at once.
